title: PrivDev: Mapping Static-Analysis Data Types to DPV
title_zh: PrivDev：将静态分析数据类型映射至DPV

paragraphs.en: Static-analysis scanners can identify personal-data types in source code, but they lack mechanisms to connect these findings to standardized privacy vocabularies. PrivDev maps 122 Bearer CLI data types to Data Privacy Vocabulary Personal Data (DPV-PD) categories and links them to potentially relevant GDPR provisions. Our approach combines deterministic mapping for 43 exact-label matches with a retrieval-grounded Large Language Model (LLM) to resolve the remaining 79 non-trivial mappings. The resulting RDF knowledge graph contains 118 ODRL policy resources that were structurally validated using SHACL. The artifact passed five complementary validation gates that cover structural correctness, query consistency, retrieval quality, LLM-based assessment, and human evaluation. In human evaluation, nine annotators produced 711 judgments, yielding a raw agreement of 0.72, Gwet’s AC1 of 0.68, and Gwet’s AC2 of 0.88. Our results indicate that the proposed mappings are plausible and reproducible, while also revealing ambiguities in scanner-defined data-type labels and coverage gaps in DPV-PD.

paragraphs.en: Software developers face a growing burden to embed privacy compliance into the systems they build. Regulations such as the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) impose concrete obligations on controllers and processors, yet the translation from legal text to implementation practice remains largely unsupported by tooling. Recent empirical work ( Matos et al., 2025 ) surveyed 88 Brazilian developers and found that most conflate privacy with security, and that 89.74% of teams handling privacy ad-hoc report using no privacy tools. This finding is consistent with earlier findings showing that developers struggle to embed privacy into software without dedicated tooling and mindset support ( Senarath and Arachchilage, 2018 ; Hadar and others, 2018 ) . They reveal a structural gap: developers write the code but do not know the law, while privacy lawyers understand GDPR but cannot read code .

paragraphs.en: Security scanners such as Bearer CLI ( Bearer, 2026 ) use static analysis to detect data types in source code, e.g. , identifying that an email address flows through a code path. However, they do not connect those data types to a privacy vocabulary or explain which obligations may warrant review. In contrast, the Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) ( J. Pandit et al., 2024 ; W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group, 2025a ) provides a machine-readable taxonomy of personal data categories, processing purposes, and legal bases, but has no direct connection to static-analysis outputs. Our literature search ( J. Pandit et al., 2024 ; Ran et al., 2025 ; Ferreira et al., 2023 ) found no approach that directly maps static-analysis datatype labels to DPV categories and links them to potentially relevant GDPR provisions.
paragraphs.zh: 像 Bearer CLI（Bearer，2026）这样的安全扫描工具使用静态分析来检测源代码中的数据类型，例如识别出电子邮件地址在某个代码路径中流动。然而，它们并未将这些数据类型与隐私词汇表关联起来，也未说明哪些义务可能需要审查。相比之下，数据隐私词汇表（DPV）（J. Pandit 等人，2024；W3C 数据隐私词汇表与控制社区小组，2025a）提供了一套机器可读的个人数据类别、处理目的和法律依据的分类体系，但并未与静态分析的输出结果直接关联。我们的文献检索（J. Pandit 等人，2024；Ran 等人，2025；Ferreira 等人，2023）发现，目前还没有任何方法能够直接将静态分析中的数据类型标签映射到 DPV 类别，并将其与可能相关的《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）条款联系起来。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents PrivDev, a security-to-privacy bridge that maps 122 Bearer CLI datatype taxonomy entries to DPV personal data (DPV-PD) categories ( pd:* ) and connects these categories to potentially relevant GDPR provisions. Methodologically, we integrate Design Science Research (DSR) ( Hevner et al., 2004 ) , the NeOn methodology ( Suárez-Figueroa et al., 2012 ) , and the Framework for Evaluation in Design Science Research (FEDS) ( Venable et al., 2016 ) to guide the design, ontology re-engineering, validation, and evaluation of PrivDev. This integration provides a systematic approach for transforming an existing static-analysis taxonomy into a machine-readable privacy artifact and evaluating it through complementary automated and human evidence.

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this paper are: (1) We propose a two-stage mapping strategy that combines deterministic matching for 43 exact-label correspondences with retrieval-grounded Large Language Model (LLM) use for 79 non-trivial mappings, enabling the systematic treatment of heterogeneous scanner-defined datatype labels. (2) We provide an RDF knowledge graph containing 118 ODRL policy resources and structurally validated using SHACL. The resulting artifact supports SPARQL-based queries that connect static-analysis data types with DPV categories and potentially relevant GDPR provisions. (3) We evaluate the artifact through five complementary validation gates covering structural correctness, SPARQL query consistency, retrieval quality, LLM-based assessment, and human evaluation. The human evaluation comprises 711 judgments from nine annotators and provides evidence of mapping plausibility while revealing ambiguities in scanner-defined datatype labels and coverage gaps in DPV-PD.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献包括：(1) 我们提出了一种两阶段映射策略，该策略将确定性匹配用于 43 个精确标签的对应关系，并结合基于检索的大语言模型（LLM）处理 79 个非平凡的映射，从而实现了对异构扫描仪定义的数据类型标签的系统性处理。 (2) 我们提供了一个 RDF 知识图谱，其中包含 118 个 ODRL 策略资源，并已通过 SHACL 进行了结构验证。 由此产生的成果支持基于 SPARQL 的查询，能够将静态分析数据类型与 DPV 类别以及可能相关的 GDPR 条款连接起来。 (3) 我们通过五个互补的验证环节对该成果进行了评估，涵盖结构正确性、SPARQL 查询一致性、检索质量、基于 LLM 的评估以及人工评估。 人工评估包括来自九名标注者的 711 项判断，既证明了映射的合理性，也揭示了扫描仪定义的数据类型标签中的模糊性以及 DPV-PD 中的覆盖缺失问题。

paragraphs.en: The Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) ( J. Pandit et al., 2024 ; W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group, 2025a ) , maintained by the W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group, provides a machine-readable taxonomy of privacy concepts. It covers personal data categories ( pd:* ), processing purposes ( pu:* ), legal bases ( lb:* ), technical and organisational measures, rights, and other concepts. Its personal-data taxonomy ( pd:* ) comprises 235 classes in DPV 2.3, which are organised under top-level categories ( e.g. , financial, health, contact, identification, location). DPV is formalised in OWL 2 (Web Ontology Language 2) 1 1 1 OWL 2 is a W3C standard for representing ontologies and their semantic relationships in a machine-readable form. and extensible through DPV-PD, DPV-OBL, and other modules. The DPV-OBL ( W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group, 2025b ) extension used in this work associates GDPR articles with data categories and processing purposes. We inherit these associations as review cues, not legal determinations of applicability, without independently validating them against legal doctrine or case law.
paragraphs.zh: 数据隐私词汇表（Data Privacy Vocabulary，DPV）（J. Pandit 等，2024；W3C 数据隐私词汇表与控制社区小组，2025a），由 W3C 数据隐私词汇表与控制社区小组维护，提供了一套机器可读的隐私概念分类体系。该词汇表涵盖个人数据类别（pd:*）、处理目的（pu:*）、法律依据（lb:*）、技术和组织措施、权利以及其他概念。其个人数据分类体系（pd:*）在 DPV 2.3 版本中包含了 235 个类，这些类被组织在顶层类别之下（例如：财务、健康、联系、身份识别、位置）。DPV 采用 OWL 2（Web Ontology Language 2）1 1 1 OWL 2 是 W3C 的一项标准，用于以机器可读的形式表示本体及其语义关系。进行形式化定义，并可通过 DPV-PD、DPV-OBL 及其他模块进行扩展。本研究使用的 DPV-OBL（W3C 数据隐私词汇表与控制社区小组，2025b）扩展模块将《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）的条款与数据类别及处理目的关联起来。我们将这些关联作为审查线索加以继承，而非将其视为适用性的法律判定，且未对这些关联进行独立于法律教义或判例法的验证。

paragraphs.en: This work encoded the derived privacy rules using three complementary W3C standards: ODRL, SHACL and SPARQL. The Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL) ( W3C, 2021 ) expresses permissions, prohibitions, and duties over digital assets ( e.g. , if a variable of type pd:Financial is processed, the duty of conducting a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) must be fulfilled). Each Bearer data type produces at least one ODRL rule under our approach. SHACL (Shapes Constraint Language) ( W3C, 2017 ) validates the resulting policies against node shapes that restrict which ODRL properties are allowed for each DPV category ( e.g. , a pd:Health mapping may expose lb:ExplicitConsent ; a pd:Financial mapping may expose retention and DPIA duties). SPARQL ( Harris and Seaborne, 2013 ) is used to write competency questions, expressed as ASK or SELECT queries, that verify each generated policy against its expected response.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作使用三种互补的 W3C 标准（ODRL、SHACL 和 SPARQL）对推导出的隐私规则进行了编码。 开放数字权利语言（ODRL）（W3C，2021）用于表达数字资产的权限、禁止和职责（例如，如果处理类型为 pd:Financial 的变量，则必须履行进行数据保护影响评估（DPIA）的职责）。 在我们的方法中，每种承载者数据类型都会生成至少一条 ODRL 规则。 SHACL（形状约束语言）（W3C，2017）用于验证生成的策略是否符合节点形状，这些形状限制了每个 DPV 类别允许使用的 ODRL 属性（例如，pd:Health 映射可能暴露 lb:ExplicitConsent；pd:Financial 映射可能暴露保留和 DPIA 职责）。 SPARQL（Harris 和 Seaborne，2013）用于编写能力问题，这些问题以 ASK 或 SELECT 查询的形式表达，用以验证每条生成的策略是否符合其预期响应。

paragraphs.en: Pandit and Esteves ( Pandit and Esteves, 2024 ) present the closest precursor to our work. They manually transform DUO (Data Use Ontology) permission and modifier codes into machine-readable ODRL + DPV policies, representing data-use restrictions, dataset policies, requests and decisions as ODRL instances and expressing privacy and legal-compliance concepts using DPV. Their validation is a proof-of-concept demonstration rather than formal schema validation. Moreover, applying a similar manual alignment process to each static-analysis scanner or personal-data detection tool would require a separate alignment effort ( Tokas et al., 2021 ; Baramashetru et al., 2025 ; Khedkar, 2023 ; Khedkar and Bodden, 2024 ) , limiting scalability across heterogeneous data-type taxonomies. This motivates our retrieval-grounded, LLM-assisted approach, which supports adaptation to other data-type taxonomies 2 2 2 The present evaluation remains limited to Bearer’s 122 data types. . Khedkar et al. ( Khedkar et al., 2026 ) extend this human-centered perspective by mapping Android source-code slices to DPV concepts to support privacy assessors during DPIAs. Their approach relies on manual curation and was evaluated through interviews with 16 participants. Instead, our pipeline automatically generates and structurally verifies ODRL/SHACL artifacts, reducing the manual effort required to establish and validate these mappings.
paragraphs.zh: Pandit 和 Esteves（Pandit and Esteves, 2024）提出了与我们工作最接近的先行研究。 他们手动将 DUO（数据使用本体论）的权限和修饰符代码转换为机器可读的 ODRL + DPV 策略，将数据使用限制、数据集策略、请求和决策表示为 ODRL 实例，并使用 DPV 表达隐私和法律合规性概念。 他们的验证是一种概念证明演示，而非正式的 schema 验证。 此外，若对每个静态分析扫描器或个人数据检测工具应用类似的手动对齐流程，则需要单独进行对齐工作（Tokas et al., 2021；Baramashetru et al., 2025；Khedkar, 2023；Khedkar and Bodden, 2024），从而限制了跨异构数据类型分类体系的扩展性。 这促使我们提出了基于检索、由 LLM 辅助的方法，该方法支持对其他数据类型分类体系的适配 2 2 2 当前评估仍局限于 Bearer 的 122 种数据类型。Khedkar et al. （Khedkar et al., 2026）通过将 Android 源代码片段映射到 DPV 概念，扩展了这种以人为中心的方法，从而在 DPIAs 期间为隐私评估人员提供支持。 他们的方法依赖于人工整理，并通过与 16 名参与者的访谈进行了评估。 相反，我们的流程能够自动生成并结构性验证 ODRL/SHACL 工件，减少了建立和验证这些映射所需的人工工作量。

paragraphs.en: This study focuses on PrivDev Layer 1 , the first layer of the proposed security-to-privacy bridge. Layer 1 maps personal-data types detected by the Bearer CLI static-analysis tool to the corresponding categories of personal data in the DPV and connects these categories to potentially relevant GDPR provisions. Future layers may extend this foundation to security weaknesses and broader privacy risks, connecting Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) security findings to the privacy layer and further relating these findings to risks defined in the OWASP Security and Privacy Top 10.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究聚焦于 PrivDev 第一层，即所提出的安全-隐私桥接模型的第一层。 第一层将 Bearer CLI 静态分析工具检测到的个人数据类型映射到 DPV 中相应的个人数据类别，并将这些类别与可能相关的《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）条款连接起来。 未来各层可扩展这一基础，涵盖安全漏洞和更广泛的隐私风险，将常见弱点枚举（CWE）的安全发现与隐私层相连接，并进一步将这些发现关联到 OWASP 安全与隐私十大风险中定义的风险。

sents.en: Figure 1 shows how the pipeline instantiates these frameworks, and the following sections describe their roles and implementation in detail.

paragraphs.en: This work adopts Hevner’s Design Science Research (DSR) framework ( Hevner et al., 2004 ) , which treats a research contribution as an artifact that must be rigorously evaluated. The Layer 1 bridge repurposes an existing resource for a new context, an exaptation in DSR terms: the Bearer taxonomy was built for security scanning rather than privacy reasoning, and re-encoding it in ODRL + DPV adapts it to this new purpose. The artifact is both a model, defining a Bearer-to-DPV mapping, and an instantiation, an executable pipeline that generates, validates, and queries that mapping.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究采用了 Hevner 的设计科学研究（DSR）框架（Hevner et al., 2004），该框架将研究贡献视为一种必须经过严格评估的产物。 第 1 层桥接将现有资源重新用于新的语境，这在 DSR 术语中属于“外源适应”：Bearer 分类体系最初是为安全扫描而非隐私推理而构建的，而将其以 ODRL + DPV 形式重新编码，则使其适应了这一新用途。 该产物既是定义 Bearer 与 DPV 映射关系的模型，也是一个实例化方案——即一个能够生成、验证和查询该映射关系的可执行流程。

paragraphs.en: NeOn ( Suárez-Figueroa et al., 2012 ) provides the construction method, Reusing and Re-engineering Non-Ontological Resources , which covers transforming classification schemes and thesauri into ontologies: here, the 122-entry Bearer taxonomy into an ODRL + DPV Turtle artifact linking each Bearer type to a DPV pd:* category.
paragraphs.zh: NeOn（Suárez-Figueroa 等人，2012）提出了“非本体资源的复用与重构”这一构建方法，该方法涵盖了将分类方案和同义词库转换为本体：在此，它将包含 122 个条目的 Bearer 分类体系转换为一个 ODRL + DPV Turtle 文件，将每种 Bearer 类型与一个 DPV pd:* 类别关联起来。

paragraphs.en: FEDS ( Venable et al., 2016 ) structures the evaluation. Neither Bearer nor DPV publishes an authoritative Bearer-to- pd:* alignment, so no ground truth exists. We therefore adopt a convergent-evidence evaluation design that combines automated structural checks (SHACL, OOPS!, and SPARQL competency questions), an LLM-judge quality assessment (DeepEval), and independent human judgment on the non-trivial mappings. Evaluation is performed during artifact construction and after the artifact is complete.
paragraphs.zh: FEDS（Venable 等人，2016）构建了评估框架。 Bearer 和 DPV 均未发布权威的 Bearer 到 pd:* 的对应关系，因此不存在基准数据。 因此，我们采用了一种收敛证据的评估设计，该设计结合了自动化的结构检查（SHACL、OOPS! 和 SPARQL 能力问题）、LLM 判官的质量评估（DeepEval），以及对非平凡映射的独立人工判断。 评估在构建成果期间以及成果完成后进行。

paragraphs.en: Prior work on tool-augmented ontology alignment finds that LLMs provided with raw OWL files can perform worse than to give the LLM access to the ontology through a retrieval/tool mechanism ( Rovai, 2026 ) . We therefore retrieve structured, per-concept chunks containing the label, skos:broader hierarchy, definition, and scope note, rather than passing the raw DPV Turtle to the mapping LLM . Retrieval uses three FAISS ( Johnson et al., 2019 ) indexes. ontology_target contains DPV-PD concepts and provides the candidate classes from which the LLM selects. detector_aliases contains synonym labels from personal-data detection tools, while sector_schema contains domain-specific field aliases; both provide supporting evidence when a Bearer label lacks a close DPV match. A two-stage retrieve-and-rerank process first uses FAISS to retrieve candidates, and then applies a cross-encoder to rank the candidates and retain a small set for the LLM. The replication package lists the index sizes, embedding model, and top- k k values.
paragraphs.zh: 关于工具增强本体对齐的早期研究发现，向大型语言模型（LLM）提供原始 OWL 文件的效果可能不如通过检索/工具机制让 LLM 访问本体（Rovai, 2026）。 因此，我们选择检索每个概念对应的结构化片段，其中包含标签、skos:broader 层级结构、定义和范围说明，而不是将原始的 DPV Turtle 文件直接传递给映射 LLM。 检索过程使用了三个 FAISS（Johnson et al., 2019）索引：ontology_target 包含 DPV-PD 概念，并提供 LLM 可供选择的候选类；detector_aliases 包含来自个人数据检测工具的同义词标签；而 sector_schema 则包含领域特定的字段别名。当某个 Bearer 标签没有与 DPV 的精确匹配时，后两者都能提供辅助证据。 该过程采用“检索-重排序”的两阶段流程：首先使用 FAISS 检索候选项，然后应用交叉编码器对候选项进行排序，并保留少量候选项供 LLM 处理。 复现包中列出了索引大小、嵌入模型以及 top-k 的 k 值。

paragraphs.en: For non-trivial entries, the LLM deepseek-v4-flash proposes the mapping . We selected this model over GPT-4o-mini because of its higher rate limit and lower per-token cost; the task did not require flagship-model reasoning. The prompt provides a compact list of pd:* IRI (Internationalized Resource Identifier), the retrieved evidence grouped into four sections (primary DPV candidate, alternatives, synonym aliases, sector-schema confirmations), and the instruction to prefer an exact label correspondence over a more specific or broader class.
paragraphs.zh: 对于非平凡的条目，LLM deepseek-v4-flash 提出了该映射。 我们选择该模型而非 GPT-4o-mini，是因为它的速率限制更高且每 token 成本更低；该任务并不需要旗舰模型的推理能力。 提示词提供了一个简洁的 pd:* IRI（国际化资源标识符）列表、按四个部分分类的检索证据（主要 DPV 候选项、替代项、同义词别名、行业-模式确认项），以及优先选择精确标签对应而非更具体或更宽泛类别的说明。

paragraphs.en: The LLM does not generate Turtle. paragraphs.en: To demonstrate the complete pipeline from the source code to potentially relevant GDPR provisions, we provide an end-to-end demonstration using OWASP Juice Shop 4 4 4 https://owasp.org/www-project-juice-shop/ as the target application (artifact and replication instructions: Artifact Availability ). A Bearer CLI dataflow scan over the Juice Shop source tree maps each personal data type detection to its source location: file, line number, field name, and enclosing object. This provenance is additive because the bridge maps only data-type names; source locations decorate the output without affecting obligation retrieval. The consolidated graph is loaded into an RDF triple store with DPV 2.3. A SPARQL SELECT query resolves each Bearer label to its pd:* category and inherited DPV-OBL provision links in one round trip. A REST API exposes this as a repository scan using a public URL. The target codebase is cloned into an isolated temporary environment, scanned, matched against the graph, and discarded before results are returned, so no user source code is retained. The query interface returns potentially relevant GDPR-provision badges and collapsible source-location provenance for a Juice Shop scan.
paragraphs.zh: 为了展示从源代码到可能相关的《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）条款的完整流程，我们使用 OWASP Juice Shop 4 4 4 https://owasp.org/www-project-juice-shop/ 作为目标应用，提供了一个端到端的演示（工件及复现说明：工件可用性）。 对 Juice Shop 源代码树执行 Bearer CLI 数据流扫描后，每个个人数据类型检测都会被映射到其来源位置：文件、行号、字段名称以及包含该数据的对象。 这种来源信息是累加的，因为桥梁仅映射数据类型名称；来源位置会作为附加信息呈现，但不会影响义务条款的检索。 整合后的图通过 DPV 2.3 加载到 RDF 三元组存储中。 一条 SPARQL SELECT 查询可在单次往返中，将每个 Bearer 标签解析为其 pd:* 类别以及继承的 DPV-OBL 条款链接。 一个 REST API 通过公共 URL 以仓库扫描的形式提供此功能。 目标代码库会被克隆到一个隔离的临时环境中进行扫描，并与图进行匹配；在返回结果前该环境即被丢弃，因此不会保留任何用户的源代码。 查询接口会返回 Juice Shop 扫描中可能相关的 GDPR 条款徽章以及可折叠的来源位置信息。

paragraphs.en: The four statistics defined in Section 3.3.2 (Equations 2 – 3 ) disagree sharply on the same data: 72.1% raw agreement versus an α \alpha of 0.251 — the high-agreement/low-kappa paradox ( Feinstein and Cicchetti, 1990 ; Gwet, 2008 ) , not a contradiction. Judgments are heavily skewed toward Correct (558/706 non-Unclear judgments), and chance corrections based on the observed marginal distribution fall sharply under this prevalence skew. Gwet’s AC1/AC2 are designed to resist this distortion. Their values of 0.68–0.88 are consistent with raw agreement rather than α \alpha . Scoring Unclear as a disagreement category instead of excluding it barely changes raw agreement (0.711 overall and 0.800 for the Article 9 subset), so the exclusion does not inflate the reported figure. Gate G4’s criterion, fixed before annotation, requires raw agreement and Gwet’s AC2 to both be ≥ 0.70 \geq 0.70 ; both thresholds are met (0.721 and 0.877 overall). Krippendorff’s α \alpha is not part of the criterion and did not determine the gate outcome; we report it for transparency. Its low Article 9 value ( α = 0.056 \alpha=0.056 , n = 10 n{=}10 ) reflects genuine disagreement in a small, high-stakes sample, consistent with the prevalence-skew instability noted above rather than a data artifact. We flag it for downstream attention rather than treating it as resolved, and report Gate G4 as passing its defined criterion.

paragraphs.en: PrivDev Layer 1 bridges security-scanner datatype signals to DPV-PD categories and machine-readable links to potentially relevant GDPR provisions. Retrieval-grounded LLM proposals are constrained by deterministic encoding and SHACL and RAG-quality routing (RQ 1 ). The SPARQL-queryable graph passed five formative gates, providing structural, retrieval-quality, and human evidence of mapping plausibility, though plausibility remains less stable for ambiguous or ontology-limited cases (RQ 2 ). Internal checks support process transparency but are not independent validation. Ambiguous scanner labels, datatype-only evidence, and DPV-PD coverage constrain precision (RQ 3 ); Layer 1 supports developer-facing privacy review rather than establishing legal compliance. The FEDS-structured convergent-evidence protocol itself — formative structural gates, an LLM-judge signal, and multi-statistic human annotation — is reusable beyond this mapping task for other LLM-assisted vocabulary-alignment work. We view this as an ongoing maintenance concern rather than a one-time check: CI-integrated re-mapping can catch drift as privacy debt accumulated over code evolution, before it compounds.
